data.name: Square Force
data.detailed_description:
SQUARE FORCE

The world didn’t end cleanly.
It fractured, warped, and started throwing things at you that shouldn’t exist — and won’t stop coming.

Square Force is a fast-paced, endless survival shooter built around one simple truth:
you are not meant to last forever.

Every run drops you into a stylized, hostile arena where the rules slowly unravel. Enemies escalate. Space collapses. Panic sets in. What begins as manageable turns into absolute chaos, and the only question that matters is how long your squad holds together before everything breaks.

SURVIVAL WITHOUT PROMISES

There is no final wave.
No escape door.
No victory screen waiting at the end.

Square Force is about momentum, pressure, and making decisions while everything is screaming at you to fail. The longer you survive, the more the game pushes back — faster enemies, stranger threats, and situations that demand movement, awareness, and teamwork under fire.

Every match tells a different story.
Most of them end badly.

FOUR PLAYERS. ONE BAD IDEA.

Survive solo or bring up to three others and experience Square Force the way it was meant to be played: together, loud, and barely holding it together.

Revive teammates in the middle of chaos.
Cover flanks that are already collapsing.
Argue about power-ups.
Make heroic last stands that almost work.

When the final player falls, the run is over.
No exceptions.

FAST. AGGRESSIVE. UNFORGIVING.

Combat in Square Force is built for speed. Standing still is a mistake. Hesitation is punished. Enemies surround, flank, swarm, and overwhelm if you give them the chance.

Switch between first-person or third-person perspectives, wield an expanding arsenal of weapons, and lean into elemental damage that can turn the battlefield into something barely controllable. The screen fills fast. The pressure never lets up.

You will panic.
That’s part of it.

POWER-UPS THAT FEEL LIKE CHEATING (UNTIL THEY DON’T)

Mid-run power-ups can completely change the flow of combat — for a moment. Whether it’s racking up points faster than you should or wiping the slate clean in a single desperate decision, these moments of relief are temporary.

Use them too early and regret it.
Use them too late and never get the chance.

A CAST THAT TALKS BACK

The survivors of Square Force aren’t silent. They react to the chaos, to each other, and to the increasingly absurd situations they’re thrown into. Expect constant commentary, bad timing, worse jokes, and lines that fire off when you least need distractions.

Not everyone copes the same way.
Some laugh.
Some yell.
Some sound like they’re losing it.

STYLIZED MAYHEM

Everything in Square Force is built around a bold, cartoon-inspired visual style with rounded shapes, exaggerated animations, and high-contrast clarity. Even when the screen fills with enemies, explosions, and effects, readability stays sharp — because the game never slows down enough to be kind.

It looks playful.
It is not gentle.

SOMETHING BIG IS COMING

If you survive long enough, you’ll notice a shift.
The ground shakes differently.
The soundscape changes.
The fight stops being fair in new ways.

Some threats don’t rush you.
They arrive.

You’ll know it when it happens.

WHAT YOU’RE REALLY FIGHTING

Square Force isn’t about winning.
It’s about endurance.
About how long coordination lasts before panic takes over.
About the moment everything goes wrong — and you keep firing anyway.

Every run ends the same way.

Just not at the same time.

FEATURES

  • Endless horde survival gameplay

  • Solo or up to 12-player co-op

  • Fast-paced first- or third-person combat

  • Elemental weapons, explosives, and upgrades

  • Dynamic power-ups that shift the fight

  • Fully voiced characters with reactive dialogue

  • Stylized visuals designed for clarity under chaos

Somewhere past the point where the screen is full, the audio is screaming, and your brain has stopped making good decisions, Square Force shows you what it really is. Not fair. Not balanced. Not impressed by how well you’re doing. Something changes. Something arrives. And suddenly the run isn’t about points or progress anymore — it’s about surviving that. You will panic. You will swear it wasn’t supposed to happen yet. And when it’s over, you’ll immediately hit restart, convinced you can do better this time. You’re wrong. But you’ll try anyway.

data.short_description: Run. Shoot. Swear. Repeat. Square Force is a fast, brutal co-op survival shooter where waves escalate, panic sets in, and surviving too long only makes things worse.

content_descriptors.notes:
Mature Content Description

Square Force contains frequent stylized violence depicted in a cartoon-like, non-realistic art style. Players use firearms, melee weapons, explosives, and elemental attacks to defeat large numbers of enemies. Combat includes enemies being shot, struck, and destroyed, but no realistic gore or graphic depictions of injury are present.

The game features strong and frequent profanity in character dialogue, including explicit language and aggressive humor. Dialogue is intended to be comedic and exaggerated in tone.

Some characters make verbal references to drug and alcohol use, presented humorously or as part of character personality. No drug or alcohol consumption is shown on screen, and there are no gameplay mechanics involving substance use.

A large boss character includes a brief non-sexual nudity gag in which protective armor breaks away, revealing a stone, statue-like anatomical feature used as a gameplay weak point. This depiction is non-realistic, non-sexualized, and presented for exaggerated, comedic effect.

Square Force does not include depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, non-consensual sexual content, self-harm, or suicide.

Players who may be sensitive to strong language, cartoon violence, implied substance references, or crude humor should take this into consideration before playing.
